tools.name: list_exams
tools.description: Without a vendor, list the certification vendors covered and how many exams each has. With a vendor (a name such as "Microsoft Azure" or a code such as "aws", "iapp", "isc2"), list that vendor's exams. Use it when the user asks which vendors or exams are covered.

tools.name: get_exam_details
tools.description: Describe one exam: the vendor's real exam (official code, question count, fee, domains and their weights) and our practice set for it (size, free questions, price, timed mock exam). `exam` is a set_id from search_exams or an official exam code. tools.name: get_study_paths
tools.description: Recommended exam order for each career role at one vendor (e.g. "aws", "Microsoft Azure"), from first exam to last. Use it when the user asks which exam to take first, or in what order, for a role.

tools.name: get_practice_questions
tools.description: Return up to five free sample multiple-choice questions for one certification exam, each with its correct option letters and a written explanation. tools.name: check_answer
tools.description: Check the user's answer to a question from get_practice_questions. Use it when the user answers one of those questions. `selected` is the option letters the user chose, e.g. ["B"] or ["A", "D"]. Returns whether it is right, the correct letters and the explanation.
